name: Spider-Man
s: Marvel's Spider-Man tells the story of an unsure (but courageous) teen who has to figure out how to be a super hero from the very beginning.

paragraphs.text: Marvel's Spider-Man is an American animated television series, based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. A replacement for the previous series Ultimate Spider-Man, the first season premiered on August 19, 2017, on Disney XD. The show was subtitled Maximum Venom for its third season, which premiered on April 19, 2020.

Dave Trumbore of Collider reviewed the series premiere, and praised the series for basing the story around Peter Parker's scientific genius, saying "it pays off in fantastic ways". Trumbore was positive about the animation saying he liked the new look, and also how "strong the writing and performances are".
